AGENTS.md

Source: AGENTS.md

Guidance for future pi sessions and subagents working in this repository.

Project shape

  • This is an R package plus data-preparation pipeline for prison mortality source extraction, cleaning, and validation.
  • Prefer the project vocabulary in docs/ubiquitous-language.md and the ADRs under docs/adr/ when naming concepts.
  • User-facing descriptions of how the project works are found in:
    • vignettes/extracting.Rmd
    • vignettes/cleaning.Rmd
  • Local planning/issues live under .scratch/<feature>/issues/. The issue tracker note is docs/agents/issue-tracker.md.

Development commands

Use just recipes rather than ad-hoc R commands when possible:

  • Setup: just setup for Docker, or just setup-local for local R.
  • Run all tests: just test
  • Run one test file: just test-module tests/testthat/test-extract.R
  • Format: just format
  • Lint: just lint
  • Regenerate docs: just docs
  • Full check: just check
  • Run arbitrary R code: just _r -q -e <CODE>

The default runner is Docker. If local R is unavailable in the harness, use the just recipes so Docker can run R.

Style and conventions

  • R indentation uses tabs, not spaces. This is enforced by .lintr.
  • Keep public API docs in roxygen comments and regenerate .Rd files with just docs after API/documentation changes.
  • README.md is generated from README.Rmd; edit README.Rmd and rebuild if README content needs changes.
  • Prefer narrow, behavior-preserving prefactors before behavior changes when duplication makes the change risky.
  • Keep extraction mechanical and source-shaped: do not add semantic cleaning, value interpretation, deduplication, or source-specific transforms to extraction.

Testing expectations

  • Add or update tests for every behavior change, especially source extraction edge cases.
  • Preserve CSV behavior when changing shared extraction code.
  • For Excel extraction, cover sidecar metadata, runtime warnings, record locators, cache/force behavior, parser failures, and config validation where relevant.
  • If you cannot run the full suite, state exactly which command failed or was unavailable.
